command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$ps=@('CampusNetwork_02','CampusNetwork_03','CampusNetwork_04','CampusNetwork_05','CampusNetwork_06','CampusNetwork_07','CampusNetwork_08','CampusNetwork_09'); `$ns=@('PE1','PE2','PE3','Core_SW_01','Core_SW_02'); foreach (`$p in `$ps) { foreach (`$n in `$ns) { `$u='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/'+`$p+'/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration'; try { `$o=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u).output; `$m=`$o -split '\r?\n' | Where-Object { `$_ -match 'isis cost|ip route-static|stp enable|ospf cost|traffic-policy|qos|shutdown$' }; if (`$m) { Write-Output ('---'+`$p+'/'+`$n+'---'); `$m | Write-Output } } catch {} } }"
